items.summary: Update the hardcoded billing address to 'Bardiha Turki - Tarvadih (Patepur-Vaishali 843110), Bihar' and ensure it appears at the top of every generated bill/invoice along with the store name

Replace the current Quagga2 barcode scanner with a zero-latency, high-performance scanner that uses enhanced decoding algorithms capable of reading barcodes even when blurred, tilted, or in low-light conditions
Add haptic feedback (phone vibration) and a success beep sound that triggers instantly upon successful barcode scan

Implement auto-quantity increment functionality so that scanning the same barcode multiple times automatically increases the quantity (e.g., Qty: 2) in the bill instead of showing an error or adding duplicate line items
Add a professional scanning overlay UI to the camera view with either a laser line or square box guide so the admin knows exactly where to point the barcode for optimal scanning
Ensure the final bill total is synced with the payment gateway for seamless checkout after barcode scanning is complete and the bill is generated

Update the camera permission description in the app settings to: 'This app uses the camera to provide a high-speed, professional barcode scanning experience for instant billing and inventory management.'
